versions.name: Camp Shands

features.note: The Taylor Dining Hall is air-conditioned.
Electrical outlets in the screened campsite pavilions.
Described by the council as northeast Florida's tallest climbing tower.
The Taylor Dining Hall, a full-service facility feeding five hundred a week.
A fish camp open to campers.
A first aid lodge with a health officer on duty around the clock.
Screened campsite pavilions with power, plus picnic pavilions at the aquatics center.
Screened nylon platform tents with two jumbo cots per Scout tent.
An aquatics center with two water slides and lap swimming.
A trained provisional Scoutmaster is provided each traditional week.
Four tree houses at Fort Hart, each sleeping up to eight Scouts.
A trading post with concessions inside the Meninak Lodge.
A lake used for boating and swim tests alongside the pool.

versions.summary: North Florida Council's Scouts BSA resident summer camp in Hawthorne, offering aquatics, COPE, climbing, and shooting sports.

provenance.notes: Imported from camp-finder; raw description and sessions dropped (operational data stays at the council site). verified_at is camp-finder's own source-confirmation date; imported_at is when open-scout-api ingested it. The evergreen summary is original prose regenerated from that description, excluding dates/fees/schedules. camp_type classified from program_types. Features surveyed 2026-07-25 against the council's own camp page (that page is explicitly not an exhaustive activity list, so absence of a code is not evidence of absence).
